audit.why: 52.27% over 2097 games. TRICKY at 7/10 is right: Akshan owns levels 1-5 on range (850 Avengerang vs 550 Five Point Strike), Akali owns everything from Perfect Execution onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart disagreed with itself in three places. Full layer read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akali/Skill/Akali; content win[] read Akshan x5, Akali, Akshan; whys[5] opened 'Skill:' while win[5] said Akali, and whys[6] opened 'Akshan:' while phases[6].side said Akali.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row and rendered different answers. The mirror audit (audits/mid/akali_mid__akshan.json) states the chart as Akshan levels 1-4, Akali 5-7, which matches Akali's real scaling.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Akali/Akali/Akali across both layers, with whys[5], whys[6], phases[4].why, phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to argue the row they sit on.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect is right: the page never named one Akali ability. The decisive interaction was also absent — Twilight Shroud makes her 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks', so Comeuppance cannot even lock onto her inside it, which is the whole reason her dive works. Shuriken Flip marking her own smoke cloud (so the dash returns her to safety) was never mentioned. phases[4].why called the ultimate 'Vengeance' — it is Comeuppance. spikes[0] called Heroic Swing a 'reset'; it is a terrain-anchored swing that gets knocked off by champion collision.
audit.why: Riot text: W 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'; E 'The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target'; R 'Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes'; Akshan R hits 'the first champion, minion, or structure hit'.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, tradeBad, spikes[1], spikes[3], mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'she has no ranged answer before level 3' in the content early block is false — Five Point Strike is a 550-range cast available at level 1.
audit.why: Riot Q text and the 550 range field. The real edge is the 300-unit range gap and her 110 energy cost at rank 1, not an absence of poke.
audit.corrected: early rewritten around the 850-vs-550 gap and the energy drain.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation' for Twilight Shroud.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 — 20s at rank 1, not fifteen. Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Perfect Execution 120/90/60, Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12, Avengerang 9/8/7/6/5.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d, mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Assassin's Mark was never mentioned, so the burst tell was missing.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'autoreset-burst-tell': spell damage rings the target and Akali empowers her next attack with bonus range on exiting the ring — the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step back.

edits.before: Akshan can zone Akali with Q boomerang poke since she has no ranged answer before level 3 and has to walk up through minions to trade. Her Q mark procs are easy to dodge with your mobility from E, and you should punish any Shroud usage by holding your own cooldowns until it drops. Avoid overextending into her E stun setups, and use your camouflage near brush to bait her into face-checking. As long as you keep range, she's stuck farming under pressure.
edits.after: Akshan zones Akali with Avengerang at 850 while Five Point Strike only reaches 550, so she has to walk into your string to trade at all. Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1, so bait two casts and she cannot follow the third. Avoid overextending into her Shuriken Flip re-cast, which dashes her to whatever the shuriken marked, and use camouflage near brush to bait her into face-checking. Keep the 550 gap and she farms under pressure.

edits.before: Level 6 is Akali's only real window: her Shroud-R combo lets her dive from stealth and burst you down if you're caught out of position, so play safer around minion waves near 6. From 7 onward your Q resets and E disengage let you out-trade her repeatedly, and you should look to shove and roam since her all-in threat resets every time you buy an item. Ward her Shroud flank routes so she can't blindside you during a side lane skirmish.
edits.after: Level 6 is Akali's real window: her Shroud-R combo lets her dive from stealth and burst you down if you're caught out of position, so play safer around minion waves near 6. Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1 and Perfect Execution 120s, so the window between them is when you shove and roam, and Comeuppance cannot lock her while she sits inside the smoke. Ward her Shroud flank routes so she can't blindside you during a side lane skirmish.

edits.before: With a completed first item Akshan out-ranges and out-kites Akali in extended trades, since your empowered Q and camo let you disengage her dash strings safely. By two items your R threatens to execute her from screen-range before she reaches you, and teamfights favor you as long as you stay on the edge of vision and pick off marked targets from afar rather than brawling in her Shroud cloud.
edits.after: With a completed AP item Akali's Five Point Strike chunks you through the Dirty Fighting shield, and Perfect Execution drops to 90 then 60 seconds. Comeuppance answers from 2500 only when she is targetable and the line is clear of minions, so fight beside a wall you can Heroic Swing off, keep your health above her execute threshold, and never contest a fight that starts inside her Shroud cloud.

notes: Derived-flag misfire: Akali's W carries the 'revealsStealth' flag, but Riot's Twilight Shroud text says nothing about revealing stealth — it only makes HER invisible and untargetable. Chart: I followed the mirror audit's stated chart (Akshan levels 1-4, Akali 5-7) rather than packet.levelChart, which had Akshan at level 6 and 2+ items while both the full layer and whys[4] argued Akali — the mirror and Akali's actual scaling agree.
